name: control-gusef-web
description: Control GUSEF — PWA responsiva (PC, iOS y Android) con Firebase y modo offline

scripts.cap:init: npx cap add android && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('android/app')) fs.copyFileSync('google-services.json','android/app/google-services.json')"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('android/app')) fs.copyFileSync('google-services.json','android/app/google-services.json')"
